notes: Names printed without a suffix are written with 'Street' (DUCK, DOLPH, HORNE, TURNER, DIVISION, FLOYD, ROVER). No street on this half is printed with an old name in brackets. Binding gutter: the left page ends at x~5750; everything east of it is the right page, which sits ~16 px higher than the left page across the gutter (Liberty's lines step up at x~5750), so the Western, Holt, Turner and Dalton picks are on the right page. Overlap with 22-10R (picked on both halves): the McLean column (Bank, Alley (Bank to Dayton block), Dayton W, Fern Alley, Exeter, York, Findlay, Poplar, Sherman, Liberty), Floyd/Bank, Alley/Floyd, Floyd/Dayton W, Fern Alley/Alley (Floyd continuation), that alley/Exeter, Western at Bank, Dayton W, Dayton, Exeter and Naeher, Division/Bank, Holt/Bank, Turner Street/Bank, Turner Alley/Bank, Turner Alley/Holt Alley, Holt/Dayton, the Alley (Findlay to Poplar, east of McLean) at Findlay, Kelly Place and Poplar, and the Dalton column (Findlay, Kelly Place, Poplar, Rover, Sherman, Liberty). McLean Avenue (100', railroad sidings in the street) flares out on its east side just south of Bank and narrows to a NNE street north of Bank, so McLean/Bank is the middle of the four block corners; the other McLean points are midway between the building lines (west ~4640-4600, east ~4955-4910). Western Avenue centre is taken midway between its building lines; the trolley track runs up to ~10-20 px NE of that near Bank. Dayton jogs at Western: the part west of Western is recorded as 'Dayton Street (west of Western)'. Floyd (printed FLOYD, 10') runs SE from the McLean/Bank corner to Dayton W; its NW mouth opens into the flared SE side of the McLean/Bank crossing, and its centreline meets Bank's centreline inside that crossing, which is the Floyd/Bank point. South of Dayton W an unnamed alley continues Floyd's line to Exeter with a ~5 ft jog at Fern Alley. Unnamed 13 ft alleys: one in the Bank-Dayton block from Garrard across McLean to Floyd; one in the Dayton-Exeter block from Garrard to McLean, which lines up with Fern Alley across McLean (so Fern Alley/McLean is a cross). A 10 ft N-S alley runs from Findlay to Poplar east of McLean (x~5270) and takes the west end of Kelly Place. Kelly Place is printed KELLY here and PLACE on 22-10R. Dolph (NOT OPENED in 1904) and Duck are open strips ending at Bank. Findlay west of McLean is open (dashed) land. Below Liberty is the plate margin (adjoining sheet 9).
